blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Species-level inventories of individual tree crowns (ITCs) from UAV imagery are limited by annotation cost: in tropical forests, many species are represented by only a handful of field-validated crowns. We propose a reliable tree recruitment framework that expands a small annotated inventory by iteratively self-training a multi-task DeepLabV3 network, combining semantic segmentation with a crown-distance regression head, on RGB UAV orthomosaics. At each iteration, candidate crowns enter the training inventory only if they pass a confidence filter on class probability and distance map and a morphology filter on crown area and solidity, with at most five new crowns per species, keeping recruited samples consistent with the reference inventory. We evaluate the framework at two Brazilian sites: an Amazonian rainforest in Acre (17 species, 355 annotated crowns, 4 cm GSD) and a forest site in the Cerrado of Maranhão (4 species, 51 annotated crowns, 1.8 cm GSD). Over 20 iterations, the number of retained crowns grew from about 500 to 960 in Acre and from about 700 to over 3100 in Maranhão, while crown-level F1 exceeded single- and multi-task DeepLabV3 baselines (53.5% vs. 50.0% and 45.2%; 92.2% vs. 79.7% and 83.6%). The framework offers a low-cost route to expanding species inventories with consumer-grade UAVs and limited fieldwork.
blocks.zh: 无人机图像中单个树冠(ITCs)的物种级清单受到注释成本的限制:在热带森林中,许多物种只代表少数有实地验证的树冠. 我们提出一个可靠的树源招聘框架,通过迭代自我训练一个多任务DeepLabV3网络,在RGB UAV矫形学上将语义分解与冠-距离回归头结合,扩大一个附加说明的小目录. 在每次迭代时,候选冠须通过班级概率和距离图的置信滤波器和冠区和坚固度的形态滤波器,每个物种最多有5个新冠,才能进入训练清单,使所招募的样本与参考清单保持一致. 我们在巴西的两个地点对框架进行评估:阿克里的亚马逊雨林(17个物种,355个标注冠,4厘米GSD)和马拉尼昂Cerrado的森林地点(4个物种,51个标注冠,1.8厘米GSD)。 超过20次重复,保留王冠的数量在阿克里从500个左右增加到960个,在马拉尼昂从700个左右增加到3100个以上,而王冠级的F1超过了单任务和多任务DeepLabV3基线(53.5%对50.0%和45.2%;92.2%对79.7%和83.6%).6%. 该框架为扩大具有消费级无人驾驶航空器和有限实地工作的物种库存提供了低成本途径。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Tropical forests are reservoirs of global biodiversity, hosting approximately two-thirds of all terrestrial species [ 1 ] . Their vastness and inaccessibility have historically posed challenges for biodiversity monitoring, making it difficult to understand how global changes affect their capacity to harbor species. However, advances in high-resolution remote sensing are ushering in a new era of tropical forest monitoring [ 2 ] . UAVs, capable of capturing imagery with centimeter-level spatial resolution, enable species detection at the individual tree crown (ITC) level [ 3 , 4 ] . This detail transforms biodiversity assessment, allowing researchers to map and monitor tree species distributions, even in tropical forests’ dense and complex canopies.
blocks.zh: 热带森林是全球生物多样性的库藏地,占所有陆地物种的约三分之二。 它们的幅员辽阔和难以获取,在历史上对生物多样性监测构成挑战,因此难以理解全球变化如何影响它们保护物种的能力。 然而,高分辨率遥感的进步正在迎来热带森林监测的新时代[2]. 无人驾驶飞行器能够以厘米空间分辨率捕获图像,能够在单个树冠一级探测物种[3,4]。 这一细节改变了生物多样性评估,使研究人员能够绘制和监测树木物种分布图,即使在热带森林密集而复杂的树冠中也是如此。

blocks.en: Current approaches for tree species mapping are based on deep learning methods, with convolutional neural networks (CNNs) standing out in this field [ 5 ] . CNNs are an artificial neural network designed to process and analyze image data by automatically learning spatial hierarchies of features through convolutional layers. These networks can capture species-specific crown structural properties in high-resolution images, enabling accurate species classification. [ 3 ] is one of the pioneering studies to identify tree species in Amazonian forests using UAV imagery and CNNs. The authors employed images with a ground sample distance (GSD) of 4 cm and reported an average accuracy of 87.8% in distinguishing four palm tree species. Euterpe precatoria , known as Açaí, a palm of economic importance, was mapped with over 98% accuracy. [ 4 ] used a CNN for semantic segmentation and UAV images acquired across different seasons to classify Amazonian tree species. They found that combining multi-season images improved species classification, reaching an average accuracy of 90.5 % in classifying eight tree species. Nonetheless, these studies were conducted in areas with relatively low tree species diversity and relied on datasets with more than 25 ITCs per species, which may have contributed to the high classification accuracies reported.
blocks.zh: 目前树种测绘方法以深层学习方法为主,演化神经网络(CNNs)在此领域站立 [5]. 有线电视新闻网是一个人工神经网络,旨在通过演化地层自动学习地物的空间分级来处理和分析图像数据. 这些网络可以在高分辨率图像中捕捉出物种特有的冠状结构属性,从而能够进行准确的物种分类. [3]是利用无人机图像和CNN识别亚马逊森林中树种的开创性研究之一. 作者使用了地面采样距离为4厘米的图像,并报告说在区分出四个棕榈树物种时平均准确度为87.8%。 Euterpe precatoria, 被称为Açaí, 具有经济重要性的棕榈, [4] 使用有线电视新闻网进行语义分解,并获得不同季节的无人机图像来分类亚马逊树种. 他们发现,结合多季图像,改善了物种分类,在将8个树种分类时,平均精确度达到90.5%. 然而,这些研究是在树种多样性相对较低的地区进行的,并依靠每个物种超过25个贸易中心的数据集,这可能促成了所报告的高度分类。

blocks.en: However, obtaining sufficient reference ITCs for training remains a challenge in tropical forests due to the difficulties of field data collection and the high diversity of species. While successful studies in controlled environments or with more common species can benefit from hundreds or thousands of labeled samples per class, the reality for many species in tropical forests is the availability of only a handful of labeled ITCs. This scarcity is especially pronounced for rare species, which are typically represented by only a few training samples [ 6 , 2 ] . Increasing the set of samples from rare species may address this issue, but this alternative requires time and proves to be costly, as shown by [ 7 ] . This data disparity limits the application of deep learning models that rely on large volumes of annotated data to achieve high performance and generalization [ 8 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,由于实地数据收集的困难和物种的高度多样性,获取足够的参考中心进行培训仍然是热带森林的一个挑战。 虽然在受控制环境中或具有更常见物种的成功研究可以受益于每类数百个或数千个被标注的样本,但对热带森林中许多物种来说,现实是只有少数被标注的国贸中心。 这种稀缺性对于稀有物种尤为明显,这些物种通常只代表少数训练样本[6,2]. 如[7]所示,增加稀有物种的样本可能解决这一问题,但这一替代品需要时间,而且费用高昂。 这种数据差异限制了深度学习模型的应用,这些模型依赖大量注解数据来实现高性能和概括[8,9].

blocks.en: Some innovative approaches have been developed to address the scarcity of labeled data for tree species classification in tropical forests. For instance, [ 10 ] proposed a multi-task fully convolutional network (MTFCN) to classify tree species in dense tropical forests using sparse polygon-level annotations from hyperspectral UAV data. Their method incorporates a partial loss function to train the network with non-dense annotations. It introduces a complementary task for distance regression, which enforces tree crown boundary constraints and enhances classification performance. The MTFCN achieved an average user’s accuracy of 88.63% and producer’s accuracy of 88.59%, improving results for underrepresented species with fewer than three ITCs in the dataset.
blocks.zh: 为解决热带森林树种分类的标签数据匮乏问题,已经制定了一些创新办法。 例如,[10]提议建立一个全面演变的多任务网络(MTFCN),利用从超光谱紫外线数据得出的稀有多边形级说明,对热带密林中的树种进行分类。 他们的方法包含一个部分损失功能来训练网络,配有非强烈说明. 它引入了距离回归的补充任务,它执行树冠边界限制,并增强分类性能. MTFCN的平均用户准确度为88.63%,生产者的准确度为88.59%,提高了数据集中所占比例不足、国贸中心不足三个的物种的成绩。

blocks.en:
Another promising approach for improving tree species mapping is active learning [ 11 , 12 ] . In an active learning pipeline, the model is initially trained on a small annotated dataset and then used to make predictions on a larger pool of unlabeled data. It then makes predictions on a larger pool of unlabeled data, identifying areas or samples where additional annotations enhance model performance.
Typically, the selected samples are those where the model exhibits the highest uncertainty or faces the most significant difficulty in making accurate predictions [ 13 ] . The selected samples are then submitted to an oracle, an agent responsible for providing new annotations to enrich the annotated dataset and improve the initial model. Usually, the role of the oracle is performed by a human annotator with knowledge of the domain of the data. Then, the new labels are added to the training set to start a new cycle of the method. This iterative process gradually improves the model’s performance until a stopping criterion is reached.
blocks.zh:
改进树种测绘的另一个有希望的方法是积极学习[11,12]。 在主动学习的管道中,该模型最初被训练在一个小的注解数据集上,然后用于在更大的无标签数据集合上进行预测. 然后在更大范围的无标签数据库上进行预测,确定附加说明能增强模型性能的领域或样本.
典型的情况是,所选取的样本是模型显示的不确定性最高或者在作出准确预测方面面临最重大困难的样本[13]. 所选取的样品随后被提交给一个甲骨文,这个代理人负责提供新的说明来丰富附加说明的数据集并改进初始模型. 通常,甲骨文的作用由了解数据领域的人文注释员来完成. 然后,在训练集中加入新的标签,开始新的方法周期. 这个迭接过程逐渐地改善了模型的性能,直到达到一个停止标准.

blocks.en: In [ 14 ] , the authors present a deep active learning strategy for object detection in UAV-obtained images, aiming to map wildlife in savanna areas. In contrast to traditional active learning techniques, in [ 14 ] , the oracle is requested to label the set where the model is most confident about its predictions. This strategy aims to reduce the number of false positives common in scenarios with rare or unbalanced classes. It aims to minimize the annotator’s efforts, who can focus on the most relevant cases. The authors show that the proposed technique achieves reasonable precision indicators, even with a lower annotation cost than conventional active learning methods. In [ 15 ] , the authors propose an active learning-based spectral-spatial classification (ALSSC) model for tree species classification in hyperspectral images. The ALSSC employs multiscale superpixels to extract spectral-spatial features and applies guided filtering to refine class probability maps while preserving edge information. Active learning is then integrated to iteratively select the most informative samples based on uncertainty, enriching the training set after each classification round. The proposed ALSSC achieved an overall accuracy of 94.86%. However, the ALSSC relies on hyperspectral imagery and performs classification at the pixel/superpixel level, rather than detecting and classifying individual tree crowns from the RGB UAV imagery used in our study.
blocks.zh: 在[14]中,作者提出了在无人驾驶飞行器所覆盖的图像中探测物体的深入积极学习战略,目的是绘制热带草原地区野生动物的地图。 与传统活性学习技巧相对,在 [14] 中,甲骨文被要求给模型对其预测最有信心的集合贴上标签. 这项战略旨在减少在罕见或不平衡类别的情况下常见的假阳性病例。 它旨在最大限度地减少注释者的努力,他们可以专注于最相关的案件。 作者们表明,拟议的技术实现了合理的精确指标,即使其注释成本低于传统的主动学习方法. 在[15]中,作者提出了基于学习的活性光谱-空间分级(ALSSC)模型,用于超光谱图像中的树种分级. ALSSC使用多尺度的超像素来提取光谱-空间特征,并应用有引导的过滤来完善类概率图,同时保存边缘信息. 然后将积极的学习结合起来,根据不确定性迭代选择信息最丰富的样本,丰富每轮分类后设定的培训内容. 拟议的ALSSC总体精确度为94.86%。 然而,ALSSC依赖于超光谱成像,在像素/超像素级别上进行分类,而不是从我们的研究中使用的RGB UAV成像中检测和分类单个树冠.

blocks.en: The examples above demonstrate the potential of active learning methods to address challenges in data-scarce scenarios and achieve high classification accuracy. However, these studies were conducted in environments with limited species diversity, such as savanna areas or controlled datasets. Despite their potential, active learning approaches have not been extensively tested in tropical forest environments, where the high species diversity and structural complexity, including dense and overlapping canopies, pose unique challenges for ITC level segmentation and classification. Thus, exploring the applicability of these methods in such biodiverse ecosystems remains an important area of research. Moreover, these approaches still rely on a human oracle to label the selected samples. When the scarce resource is botanical expertise in the field, a natural question is whether the model itself can act as the oracle, that is, whether reliable pseudo-labels can be selected automatically in a self-training fashion, without new manual annotation, to identify tree species at the ITC level.
blocks.zh: 以上例子表明,积极学习方法有潜力应对数据稀缺情景中的挑战并实现高分类精度. 然而,这些研究是在物种多样性有限的环境中进行的,例如草原地区或受控制的数据集。 积极学习方法尽管具有潜力,但在热带森林环境中尚未得到广泛试验,因为热带森林的物种多样性和结构复杂性高,包括树冠密集和重叠,对国贸中心一级的分化和分类构成独特的挑战。 因此,探索这些方法在这种生物多样性生态系统中的应用性仍然是一个重要的研究领域。 此外,这些方法仍然依靠人类甲骨文来给选定的样品作标签。 当稀有的资源是该领域的植物学专门知识时,一个自然的问题就是模型本身能否起到甲骨文的作用,即可靠伪标签是否能够以自我训练的方式自动选择,而无需新的人工注释,以识别ITC一级的树种.

blocks.en: In this work, we address the problem of expanding forest species inventories from a limited number of annotated individual tree crowns (ITCs). We propose a reliable tree recruitment framework that progressively enlarges forest inventories through the automatic incorporation of high-confidence tree crowns validated by crown morphology. The proposed framework is implemented through an iterative self-training (pseudo-labeling) strategy combining semantic segmentation, confidence estimation and morphology-aware pseudo-label validation. By progressively expanding the inventory, the proposed approach improves species detection and classification while substantially reducing manual annotation requirements.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们处理利用有限数量的附加说明的个别树冠来扩大森林物种清单的问题。 我们建议建立一个可靠的树种招募框架,通过自动纳入经花冠形态验证的高自信树冠来逐步扩大森林库存。 拟议框架通过迭代自训练(pseudo-labeling)战略得到实施,该战略结合了语义分解、信心估计和形态认识伪标签验证。 通过逐步扩大库存,拟议办法改进了物种检测和分类,并大大减少了人工注释要求。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献:

blocks.en: 1. We propose a framework for reliable tree recruitment that progressively expands forest species inventories from a small set of annotated individual tree crowns while preserving inventory quality. 2. We introduce a morphology-aware recruitment strategy that combines confidence estimation and crown morphology validation to automatically identify reliable candidate trees. 3. We implement the proposed recruitment strategy through a multi-task semantic segmentation framework and demonstrate consistent improvements across two tropical forest datasets.

blocks.en: This approach supports scalable biodiversity monitoring by enabling the model to act as an automated oracle for label generation, reducing the reliance on manual annotation.

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II presents a detailed description of the proposed tree recruitment framework. Section III describes the training and validation procedures as well as the datasets used in this study. Section IV reports the performance of the proposed method under different scenarios. Finally, Section V summarizes the main findings and outlines directions for future work.

blocks.en: II Deep Automatic Tree Recruitment for Forest Species Mapping using Multitask Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: II 利用多任务语义分解法为森林物种绘图进行深自动树招募

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : Overview of the proposed framework. (1) Training the ML model with the labeled samples. (2) Predicted semantic segmentation and the distance map by the multi-task model. (3) Prediction refined with a confidence threshold above 70% and distance map value above 0.25. (4) Final Individual Tree Crowns (ITCs) selected and prepared for the tree recruitment scheme’s sample inventory, incorporating morphological validation.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议框架概览。 (1) 以标有标签的样品培训ML模型。 (2)由多任务模型预示的语义分解和相距图. (3) 预测精炼,置信阈值为70%以上,相距图值为0.25以上. (4) 选定和编制最后个人树冠,用于树种采样计划,包括形态鉴定。

blocks.en: This section presents the proposed reliable tree recruitment framework for progressive forest inventory expansion under scarce annotations. As illustrated in Figure 1 , the framework follows an iterative process in which newly recruited tree crowns are automatically incorporated into the inventory after confidence and morphology validation. The recruitment strategy is implemented through a self-training workflow combining multi-task semantic segmentation and iterative pseudo-label refinement.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍在稀缺说明下逐步扩大森林清单的拟议可靠树种征聘框架。 如图1所示,该框架遵循一个迭接过程,在信心和形态验证后,新招聘的树冠自动纳入清单。 征聘战略是通过一个自我培训工作流程实施的,该工作流程将多任务语义分类和迭代假标签改进结合起来。

blocks.en: The workflow begins with an initial set of labeled data, which trains a multi-task deep learning model. This model then processes unlabeled data, its predictions to identify high-confidence samples. An aspect of this process involves the selection of pseudo-labels, refined not only by model confidence and distance transform outputs but also validated through crown morphology heuristics. These selected samples are then integrated into the training dataset, improving the model’s ability to identify and classify ITCs with reduced reliance on extensive manual annotation. This integrated approach aims to ensure generalization and high classification accuracy across diverse species, including those that are underrepresented.
blocks.zh: 工作流程起先是一套被贴上标签的初始数据,它训练出一种多任务深度学习模式. 这个模型然后处理无标签的数据,它的预测可以识别出高自信样本. 这一过程的一个方面涉及选取伪标签,不仅通过模型置信度和相距变换输出加以改进,而且还通过冠状高血压验证. 这些选定的样本随后被并入培训数据集,提高了模型识别和分类贸易中心的能力,减少了对大量人工说明的依赖。 这一综合办法旨在确保在各种物种,包括代表性不足的物种中实现普遍性和高分类准确性。

blocks.en: II-A Overall Multi-Task Architecture
blocks.zh: II-A 总体多任务结构

blocks.en: As depicted in Figure 1 (step 1), the tree recruitment cycle begins with the training of a ML model which consist in a deep learning (DL)-based multi-task framework. Figure 2 provides a conceptual overview of this multi-task architecture. Following [ 10 ] , the multi-task network aims at producing two different outputs by processing an input UAV image. The first prediction is a semantically labeled image (representing the main classification task) and the second is a distance transform map (serving as an auxiliary regression task). The architecture comprises a shared encoder network and two specialized decoder networks, each tailored to its respective task. This design capitalizes on the ability of the shared encoder to extract hierarchical features common to both tasks, while the separate decoders allow for task-specific optimization. The synergy between these tasks enables the model to learn more robust features and improve the precision of individual tree crown boundaries.
blocks.zh: 如图1所描述的(第1步),树招募周期始于培训一个ML模型,该模型包含一个以深层学习为基础的多任务框架。 图2概述了这一多任务架构的概念。 [10]之后,多任务网络旨在通过处理一个输入的无人机图像来产生两种不同的输出. 第一种预测是标注成像(代表主分类任务),第二种是相距变换图(服务于辅助回归任务). 该架构包括一个共享编码器网络和两个专门的解码器网络,每个网络都适合各自的任务. 这种设计利用了共享编码器提取两种任务所共有的分级特征的能力,而单独的解码器则允许任务特定优化. 这些任务之间的协同作用使模型能够学习更坚固的特征并改进单个树冠边界的精度.

blocks.en: II-A 2 Distance transform as auxiliary task
blocks.zh: 二级A级 2 远距离转换作为辅助任务

blocks.en: In this work, a method similar to that proposed by [ 10 ] was utilized to enhance the generalizability of the network. This method integrates an auxiliary task into the model, serving as a regularizer. Here, the network is trained to learn a regression function that maps the input image to a distance map transform. This approach has been proven to be effective in applications such as mapping tree species [ 21 , 22 ] and automatically delineating tree crowns [ 23 ] in tropical environments.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,采用了类似于[10]所提议方法的方法来增强网络的普遍性。 这种方法将一个辅助任务整合到模型中,起到常态化的作用. 在这里,网络被训练来学习一个回归函数,将输入图像映射到相距图变换. 事实证明,这种方法在绘图树种[21,22]等应用中是有效的,在热带环境中自动划定树冠[23].

blocks.en: To construct the training set for the distance map transform, the labels of each ITC underwent several processing steps. Initially, binary masks that corresponded to each ITC were generated. Subsequently, a distance map, denoted as d , was calculated for each component of the binary image using the euclidean distance transform (EDT). This transformation produces a distance map where the value assigned to each internal pixel of the instances indicates the Euclidean distance to the nearest boundary.
blocks.zh: 为构建远程地图转换的培训集,每个国贸中心的标签都经过了几个处理步骤。 最初,产生了与每个贸易中心对应的二进制口罩。 随后,使用euclidea距离变换(EDT)计算出二进制图像每个组件的相距图,表示为d. 此变换产生一个相距图, 其中给实例的每个内部像素分配的值表示欧几里德到最近边界的相距 。

blocks.en: A Gaussian filter is applied to smooth the distance map transformation, primarily to mitigate noise and irregularities in the data. The selected variance, ( σ = 30 ) (\sigma=30) , strikes a reasonable balance between retaining essential features in the distance map and eliminating unwanted noise. This specific value for σ \sigma was determined empirically, based on visual inspection and preliminary tests that showed optimal smoothing for capturing crown morphology variations without over-blurring critical boundary information. Due to the variability in canopy sizes—even among trees of the same species—normalization of the distance transform was necessary for each ITC. This normalization rescales the maximum values for each ITC to 1, so that they refer to the center of the crown, as illustrated in Figure 3 c.

This constraint helps to more accurately delineate ITCs, including those classified under the same semantic group. blocks.en: II-B Automatic Tree Recruitment Methodology
blocks.zh: II-B 自动树种征聘方法

blocks.en: This section details the proposed tree recruitment methodology, an iterative, model-guided approach designed to efficiently generate high-quality pseudo-labels to address the high cost of manual annotation. The complete tree recruitment cycle is illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍了拟议的树种招聘方法,这是一种迭代的,有模型指导的方法,旨在高效地生成高质量的伪标签,以解决人工注释的高成本. 图1说明了整个树的采树周期。

blocks.en: II-B 1 Dense Prediction over the Study Area
blocks.zh: II-B 1 对研究区的密集预测

This process yields a likelihood map P S ∈ 𝐑 W × H × C P_{S}\in\mathbf{R}^{W\times H\times C} (indicating class membership probability for each pixel) and a distance map D S ∈ 𝐑 W × H D_{S}\in\mathbf{R}^{W\times H} (encoding the distance of each pixel to the nearest ITC boundary) over the full orthoimage. Individual ITC candidate components are then extracted from these dense predictions for subsequent filtering.

blocks.en: II-B 2 Confidence and Morphology Criteria
blocks.zh: II-B 2 信心和口腔学标准

blocks.en: Following the prediction stage, two key criteria are computed to select the most informative pseudo-labeled samples for further training (Step 3 in Figure 1 ): confidence and morphology.
blocks.zh: 在预测阶段之后,将计算出两个关键标准,以选择信息最丰富的伪标签样本供进一步培训(图1步骤3):信心和形态。

blocks.en: Confidence-based Criteria: This criterion exploits the probability maps P S P_{S} and the distance map D S D_{S} . Pixels from the segmented images are selected if their class membership probability indicates high certainty, specifically when classified with at least 70% confidence. This threshold balances the number of pixels included with the reliability of their classification. The distance map D S D_{S} further refines ITC delineation through a 0.25 threshold on its normalized values, set empirically after testing values from 0.10 to 0.30 on the validation set. Below this threshold, residual boundary noise degraded the delineation; above it, the crowns were over-eroded.

blocks.en: Morphology-based Criteria: Only instances that morphologically resemble an ITC are selected. This involves two sub-criteria: • Crown Area: Instances with crown areas closest to their respective species’ median area are chosen. Experimental results demonstrate that the median identifies representative ITCs. • Solidity: A filter is applied using the solidity metric, defined as the ratio of a geometric object’s area to its convex hull’s area. This metric quantifies how closely an instance approximates a convex shape. Components deviating from a convex form are discarded, aligning with the observed convex and rounded shapes of ITCs in the initial training set. These selection steps ensure that only reliable and morphologically sound samples are considered for subsequent training.
blocks.zh: 基于肿瘤的标准: 只有形态上与国贸中心相似的情况才被选定。 这涉及两项次级标准: 冠地:选择的冠地最接近各自物种中位地的事例。 实验结果表明,中位数确定了具有代表性的国贸中心。 固态性:采用固态度量法,即几何物体面积与其对流壳面积之比。 这种度量法将一个实例近似于对流形状。 偏离对流形态的部件被丢弃,在初始培训中与观察到的对流和圆形的贸易中心相配合。 这些选择步骤确保以后的培训只考虑可靠和形态上健全的样品。

This metric quantifies how closely an instance approximates a convex shape. Components deviating from a convex form are discarded, aligning with the observed convex and rounded shapes of ITCs in the initial training set.

blocks.en: II-B 3 Storage and Selection from Sample Inventory
blocks.zh: II-B 3 储存和选取抽样清单

blocks.en: The validated pseudo-labeled ITCs, selected based on confidence and morphology criteria, are then considered and stored in a sample inventory (Step 4 in Figure 1 ). This inventory accumulates reliable components across iterations. If a sample already exists at a specific location, the older instance is replaced by the newly obtained, potentially refined shape from the most recent iteration. This replacement applies only to pseudo-labels within the inventory. The manually annotated ITCs from the initial training set remain unchanged throughout all iterations and are never overwritten by model predictions.
blocks.zh: 根据置信度和形态标准选择的经验证的假标签的贸易中心,随后被考虑并储存在样本清单中(图1第4段)。 该清单在整个重复中积累了可靠的组件。 如果在特定地点已经存在样本,则用最近重复产生的新得到的、可能精细的形状来取而代之。 这一替换仅适用于库存中的伪标签。 最初培训中人工附加说明的贸易中心在所有周期中保持不变,从未被模型预测所取代。

blocks.en: II-B 4 Training Set Update and Iteration
blocks.zh: II-B 4 培训集更新和迭代

blocks.en: From the sample inventory, a maximum of five new ITCs per species (not previously part of the training data) are selected to update the current training set (Step 5 in Figure 1 ). This species-balanced selection aims to maintain data stability and prevent overrepresentation of certain species. The updated training set, which now includes both the original labeled data and the newly selected high-confidence pseudo-labels, is then used for the next iteration of model training, restarting the cycle at Step 1. This iterative expansion of the training set with diverse and informative samples improves the model’s ability to identify and classify ITCs, leading to increased detection of ITCs per species while maintaining high classification accuracy.
blocks.zh: 从抽样清单中,每个物种最多选择了五个新的国贸中心(以前不是培训数据的一部分)来更新目前的培训集(图1第5步)。 这一物种平衡选择旨在保持数据稳定性并避免某些物种的代表性过高。 更新后的培训集现在既包括了原有的被标注的数据,也包括了新选择的高自信伪标签,然后被用在了模型培训的下一轮迭代上,于第1步重新开始循环. 这套培训的迭接性扩大,提供了各种资料,提高了模型确定和分类贸易中心的能力,从而增加了对每个物种的贸易中心的检测,同时保持了较高的分类准确性。

blocks.en: The detection step is the same at every iteration, including the final one: the confidence thresholds ( P S ≥ 70 % P_{S}\geq 70\% and normalized D S ≥ 0.25 D_{S}\geq 0.25 ) and the morphology criteria (crown area close to the species’ median and the solidity filter described in Section II-B ) are applied unchanged. The final inventory reported in the experimental analysis corresponds to the state of the sample inventory at the last iteration (e.g., the 13th and 20th iterations referenced in Figures 14 and 15 ), obtained by applying the model trained in that iteration to the entire study area and filtering its dense predictions through the same confidence and morphology pipeline.
III Experimental analysis
blocks.zh: 三. 实验分析

blocks.en: This section details the experimental design and setup developed to evaluate the performance of the proposed deep tree recruitment framework. It encompasses a description of the study areas, the methodology for UAV image acquisition, the characteristics of the individual tree crown (ITC) datasets, and the specific configuration of the multi-task CNN architecture. Furthermore, the section outlines the training protocols, including data augmentation and optimization strategies, and the metrics used for model evaluation.
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍为评价拟议的深树采伐框架绩效而制订的实验设计和设置. 它包含了对研究领域的描述,无人机图像获取方法,单个树冠数据集的特征,以及多任务CNN架构的具体配置. 此外,本节概述了培训协议,包括数据扩充和优化战略,以及用于模型评价的衡量标准。

blocks.en:
In region (A), aerial photographs were collected in November 2017 (rainy season) using a DJI Phantom 4 Pro unoccupied aerial vehicle (UAV) equipped with an RGB (red, green, blue) CMOS sensor. The sensor had a resolution of 20 megapixels and was fitted with a 24 mm autofocus lens and manual shutter.
The aerial survey was conducted at a flight altitude of 120 meters above the forest canopy, with the UAV maintaining a cruising speed of 10 m/s . This configuration resulted in images with a ground sampling distance (GSD) of 4 cm , providing high-resolution forest canopy data. Before the flights, three ground control points (GCPs) were established on the edges of the forest reserve to ensure geometric accuracy for the entire area. These GCPs were surveyed using dual-frequency GNSS receivers, collecting GPS and GLONASS data for 241 minutes. Post-processing of the GCP data yielded an average vertical precision of 10 cm and a horizontal precision of 3 cm . This configuration, combined with the flight plan, ensured optimal geometric correction and minimal distortion across the reconstructed orthomosaic. The raw UAV images were then processed using structure-from-motion photogrammetry software to generate a high-resolution orthomosaic and a Digital Surface Model (DSM). Standard photogrammetric workflows were applied, including bundle adjustment and dense cloud generation, followed by orthorectification and mosaicking to produce the final imagery used for analysis.

blocks.en: On the other hand, in region (B), a total of 254 hectares with native vegetation were surveyed in July 2023, during the dry season, using a DJI Mavic 2 Pro (M2P) UAV. The drone was flying at a height of 120 meters with 85 % front and side overlap, resulting in 15 regions of 1.8 cm/pixel resolution and three channels (RGB). Although these regions are essentially dense forests, they also have parts covered by roads and plantations. These areas can be observed in Figure 4 where 3 of the 15 regions are represented. Simultaneously with the drone imagery, field data was collected in the same period from 45 plots each 900 m 2 m^{2} in size, where 90 species belonging to 36 families were identified. blocks.en: III-C CNN architecture
blocks.zh: 三C有线电视新闻网架构

blocks.en: The network architecture, conceptually depicted in Figure 2 , is a multi-task CNN designed for simultaneous semantic segmentation and distance transform. This DeepLabV3-based framework [ 16 , 10 ] employs a shared encoder network, built upon the ResNet-50 architecture [ 17 ] , responsible for extracting hierarchical feature representations from the input image. The ResNet-50 structure is composed of 50 layers, including 16 residual blocks and 48 convolutional layers. As prescribed by the DeepLabV3 architecture [ 16 ] , the strided convolutions in the two deepest residual stages (layer3 and layer4) are replaced with atrous convolutions (dilation rates of 2 and 4, respectively), resulting in an output stride of 8 rather than the original 32. The encoder thus produces feature maps at 1/8 of the input spatial resolution, retaining finer spatial detail for pixel-level prediction. Pre-trained weights on the COCO Train 2017 dataset were used to initialize the network.
blocks.zh: 在图2中概念上描绘的网络架构是一个多任务CNN,旨在同时进行语义分解和距离变换. 这个基于DeepLabV3的框架[16,10]采用了基于ResNet-50架构的共享编码器网络[17],负责从输入图像中提取分级特征表示. ResNet-50结构由50个地层组成,包括16个剩余地块和48个回旋地层. 按照DeepLabV3架构[16]的规定,两个最深残留相(层3和层4)的被扭曲的相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 因此编码器在输入空间分辨率的1/8时生成地物图,为像素级的预测保留更细的空间细节. 在COCO 2017列车数据集上预训重量被使用来初始化网络.

blocks.en: Branching from this shared encoder, two specialized decoder networks operate in parallel, as illustrated in Figure 2 . One decoder is dedicated to the main task of semantic segmentation, assigning a tree species label to each pixel. The other decoder handles the auxiliary task of distance transform, predicting the Euclidean distance from each pixel to the nearest ITC boundary. This multi-task design enables precise ITC delineation and classification by combining the discriminative power of segmentation with the boundary-aware regularization of the distance transform, proving suitable for our tree recruitment strategy.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,从这个共享编码器中分出两个专门的解码器网络平行运作。 一个解码器专门执行语义分化的主要任务,为每个像素分配一个树种标签. 另一个解码器处理相距变换的辅助任务,预测从每个像素到最近的ITC边界的欧几里德相距. 这种多任务设计使国贸中心能够通过将分化的歧视性力量同距离变换的边界意识正规化结合起来,进行精确的划定和分类,事实证明这适合我们的树种取用战略。

blocks.en: III-D Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 三-D 实验装置

blocks.en: In both datasets, the tree recruitment cycle started from the training ITCs listed in Tables I and II (355 crowns for Amazon AC and 51 crowns for Bioflore MA). To facilitate efficient processing and optimize memory consumption, images were processed as patches of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels for Amazon AC and 256 × 256 256\times 256 in Bioflore MA, with a batch size of 32. For patch selection, a pixel within an ITC was randomly chosen, and the patch dimensions were defined around this pixel. The distance from the selected pixel to the left edge and the top margin varied randomly between 1% and 99% of the patch’s total dimension. This strategy, illustrated in Figure 7 , ensured consistent training with patches containing segmented pixels and presented the model with diverse positional contexts for the same sample.
blocks.zh: 在这两个数据集中,从表一和表二所列培训中心(亚马逊AC为355个冠,Bioflore MA为51个冠)开始树上招聘周期。 为了便于高效处理并优化内存消耗,图像被加工成512×512 512\times 512像素为亚马逊AC和256×256256\times 256于Bioflore MA的补丁,分批大小为32. 对于补丁选择,ITC内部的一个像素被随机选择,而补丁维度被围绕这个像素定义. 从所选像素到左边缘和上边的距离在补丁总维度的1%到99%之间随机变化. 图7所示的这一战略确保了包含分形像素的补丁的一致培训,并为同一样本提出了具有不同位置背景的模型。

blocks.en: Differences in the number of samples and segmented pixels were observed among tree species (as detailed in Tables I , II ), leading to data imbalance that could potentially bias classification. To counteract this, an oversampling strategy was implemented to ensure a uniform representation of each tree species during training. Furthermore, to compensate for the limited annotated data, data augmentation techniques were applied randomly at each training epoch, including random rotations (90°, 180°, and 270°) and vertical and horizontal flips. To prevent overfitting, a dropout layer with a rate of 50% was also integrated into the classification task. Additionally, in our experiments, the γ \gamma parameter in equation 1 was set to 2 based on empirical tests and common practices in similar semantic segmentation tasks to address class imbalance.
blocks.zh: 在树种之间观察到了样本和分型像素数量的差异(详见表一和表二),导致数据不平衡,可能偏向分类。 为了应对这种情况,实施了过度采样战略,以确保在培训期间每个树种都有统一的代表。 此外,为了补偿附加说明的有限数据,在每个培训阶段随机应用数据增强技术,包括随机旋转(90°、180°和270°)以及纵向和横向翻转。 为防止过度调整,还把50%的辍学率纳入分类工作。 此外,在我们的实验中,方程式1中的γ\gamma参数被设定为2个,其依据是类似语义分解任务中的经验测试和常见做法,以解决阶级不平衡问题.

blocks.en: The complete tree recruitment cycle, depicted in Figure 1 , was executed for 20 iterations. In each iteration, the model underwent training for a maximum of 30 epochs, with 5000 samples per epoch. The number of epochs was adjusted using an early stopping mechanism: training ceased if the F1-Score improvement on the validation set was less than 0.001 for five consecutive epochs. A validation set, constituting 20% of the training set (ensuring at least one sample of each ITC per dataset), was separated at the start of each iteration’s training. The network’s optimization was performed using the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) optimizer with a momentum of 0.9, an initial learning rate of 0.01 with a linear warmup over 5 epochs and cosine annealing to 1e-4. The network was initialized with weights pre-trained on the COCO 1 1 1 https://cocodataset.org/#home Train 2017 dataset.
blocks.zh: 图1所描述的整棵树的采伐周期为20次迭代。 在每个周期,该模型都接受了最多30个世纪的培训,每个世纪有5000个样本。 使用早期停止机制来调整时间段数:如果验证集的F1-分数改进在连续5个时间段上低于0.001,则停止培训. 在每套培训开始时,将一组鉴定件分开,占培训件的20%(每个数据集至少有一个贸易中心样本)。 网络的优化利用了有历史意义的梯度回流(SGD)优化器进行,其动力为0.9,初始学习率为0.01,线性热能超过5个纪元,而余弦反射为1e-4。 该网络在COCO 1 1上进行了预先加权培训。 2017年列车数据集.

blocks.en: Following [ 10 ] , at inference time, we applied the trained network to overlapping image tiles using a sliding window strategy, averaging overlapping patch predictions pixel-wise, and improving results by considering different overlap rates. Hence, we generated the classification outputs for 30% and 50% overlap and took the average as the final outcome. In the same way as proposed in [ 10 ] , we averaged the outputs to obtain an outcome with the input orthoimage dimensions.
blocks.zh: 之后[10],在推论时间,我们利用滑动窗口策略将训练有素的网络应用于相重叠的图像平板,平均相重叠的补丁预测像素,并通过考虑不同的相重叠率来改进结果. 因此,我们产生了30%和50%的分类产出重叠,并将平均数作为最后结果。 正如[10]中所建议的那样,我们估计了产出,以取得输入正切维度的结果。

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on an Ubuntu 22.04 operating system, utilizing an AMD EPYC 7V13 CPU with 256GB of RAM, and an NVIDIA A100 graphics card with 80GB of VRAM. The entire model implementation was developed using the PyTorch framework.

blocks.en: A consideration regarding the performance metrics stems from the nature of the remote sensing datasets used in this study. Unlike many semantic segmentation tasks that often benefit from exhaustive, pixel-level annotations across the entire image, our data does not provide this complete level of detail. Instead, we possess a limited set of annotated ITCs, represented as polygons within the image space, specifically for the tree species of interest.
blocks.zh: 关于性能衡量尺度的考虑源于本研究所使用的遥感数据集的性质。 与许多语义分解任务不同,这些任务往往得益于整个图像中详尽无遗的,像素级的说明,我们的数据并没有提供这种完整的分解层次的细节. 相反,我们拥有一套有限的附加说明的贸易中心,在图像空间内以多边形表示,具体针对感兴趣的树种。

blocks.en: This characteristic directly constrains our evaluation methodology, making the computation of traditional segmentation metrics, such as pixel-level Precision and Recall, unfeasible across the entire image. To ensure an assessment of the model’s performance, we calculated metrics at the ITC level. Each annotated ITC was treated as an individual instance, and the model’s evaluation focused on its correct detection and classification, similar to an image classification task where each object is assessed individually. The final class prediction was determined by the majority class within the polygon region. This approach quantifies the model’s ability to accurately identify existing ITCs and assign them to the correct class, thereby aligning the evaluation with both the characteristics of the available data and the objectives of the task.
blocks.zh: 这个特征直接制约了我们的评价方法,使得传统的分解度度量的计算,如像素水平的精度和回想等,在整个图像中都是不可行的. 为确保对该模型的业绩进行评估,我们在贸易中心一级计算了衡量标准。 每个附加说明的贸易中心都被视为个别实例,该模型的评价侧重于其正确的检测和分类,类似于图像分类任务,即每个物体单独评估。 最后的类预测由多边形区域内的多数类决定. 这种办法将模型准确确定现有贸易中心的能力量化,并将其划入正确的类别,从而使评价与现有数据的特点和任务的目标相一致。

blocks.en: IV Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 四. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: In this section, we present the results of the experiments conducted in this study. We start by comparing the performances of DL-based models already proposed in the literature, e.g. DeepLabV3 [ 16 ] , and the Multi-Task method proposed in [ 10 ] against the results obtained by the proposed method on each site. Next, we present results obtained by each specie and visually analyze the classification difficulties derived from the set of individual predictions of the evaluated methods.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍在本研究中进行实验的结果。 我们首先比较文献中已经提出的基于DL的模型的性能,如DeepLabV3[16],以及[10]中提议的多任务方法与每个站点上的拟议方法获得的结果. 接着,我们介绍每个小类获得的结果,并对评估方法的一系列个别预测所产生的分类困难进行视觉分析。

blocks.en: It can be observed by inspecting Table III that the proposed method is consistently superior across all evaluated metrics ,i.e., F1-score, Precision, and Recall, for both the Amazon AC and BioFlore MA datasets. Specifically, in the Amazon AC dataset, our approach achieved the highest scores with 53.5% F1-score, 55.9% Precision, and 54.6% Recall. Similarly, it outperformed all other methods in the BioFlore MA dataset, registering 92.2% F1-score, 95.0% Precision, and 91.6% Recall.
blocks.zh: 通过检查表三可以看出,拟议的方法在所有评价的计量中始终优于Amadon AC和BioFlore MA数据集,即F1-分数、精度和召回。 具体来说,在亚马逊AC数据集中,我们的方法取得了最高的分数,以53.5%的F1-分数,55.9%的精度和54.6%的回调. 同样,它在BioFlore MA数据集中的表现超过了所有其他方法,登记了92.2%的F1-分数,95.0%的精度,91.6%的回调.

blocks.en: A general trend observed across all methods is a higher performance on the BioFlore MA dataset compared to Amazon AC. This evidences the differences with respect to characteristics such as inter-class variability, clearer object boundaries (see Figures 5 and 6 ) that make the Amazon AC dataset more challenging. Striking is the performance of the multi-task baseline [ 10 ] on the Amazon AC dataset, where it recorded an F1-score of 45.2%, along with a Precision (47.3%) and Recall (47.6%). This result indicates a limitation on the Amazon AC dataset, a point that warrants investigation in the subsequent steps of this work.
blocks.zh: 在所有方法中观察到的一个普遍趋势是,比起亚马逊大气控制系统,BioFlore MA数据集的性能更高. 这证明了在诸如类间可变性,更清晰的物体边界(见图5和图6)等特性上的差异,这使得亚马逊AC数据集更具挑战性. Striking是亚马逊AC数据集上的多任务基线[10]的性能,它记录的F1-分数为45.2%,还有精度(47.3%)和回调(47.6%). 这一结果表明对亚马逊AC数据集的限制,这一点值得在这项工作的后续步骤中进行调查.

blocks.en: While DeepLabV3 served as a baseline, demonstrating competitive results in BioFlore MA with an F1-score of 79.7%, it was consistently outperformed by the proposed method and the multi-task proposal from [ 10 ] . This superiority, especially when contrasted with the performance obtained by the established multi-task baseline, highlights the benefits derived by including the proposed tree recruitment strategy. These results underscore the potential of our contributions in advancing multi-task learning for challenging environmental remote sensing data.
blocks.zh: 虽然DeepLabV3作为基线,在BioFlore MA中显示竞争结果,F1-分数为79.7%,但是由于拟议方法和[10]的多任务提议,它的业绩一直高于。 这种优越性,尤其是与既定的多任务基线取得的业绩相比,突出了列入拟议的树种征聘战略所产生的效益。 这些成果突出表明了我们在推进多任务学习以挑战环境遥感数据方面的潜力。

blocks.en: To provide a deeper, species-level understanding of the previously analyzed overall results, Figures 8(a) and 8(b) present the detailed F1-score (%) obtained by each evaluated method for individual species within the Amazon AC and BioFlore MA datasets, respectively. In these figures, each cluster of bars represents the performance for a specific species. The green bars correspond to the Multi-task baseline proposed by [ 10 ] , the yellow bars illustrate the DeepLabV3 [ 16 ] results, and the blue bars depict the performance achieved with the proposed method.
blocks.zh: 为了更深入地从物种层面了解先前分析的总体结果,图8(a)和图8(b)分别介绍了亚马逊大气控制区和BioFlore MA数据集内每种评估方法获得的详细F1-分数(%)。 在这些数字中,每组条代表特定物种的性能. 绿条对应[10]提出的多任务基线,黄条说明了DeepLabV3[16]结果,而蓝条则描绘了采用所提议方法实现的性能.

blocks.en: As corroborated by the overall findings in Table III , all evaluated methods demonstrated performance on the BioFlore MA dataset, with F1-scores generally surpassing 60%, and for the leading approaches, frequently exceeding 80%, see Figure 8(b) . Within this dataset, Qualea parviflora presented the most significant segmentation challenge, yielding the lowest F1-scores across all models. A potential explanation for this difficulty may stem from the nature of its canopy structure, which, despite its complexity, might share subtle morphological characteristics with Pterodon emarginatus species present in the dataset, see Figure 6 . This inter-species resemblance could lead to increased ambiguity for the models, hindering precise differentiation and subsequently impacting segmentation accuracy for Qualea parviflora . Conversely, higher performances were observed for species such as Salvertia convallariodora and Tachigali aurea where models achieved F1-scores between 80% and 100%. The proposed method outperformed DeepLabV3 across most species in this dataset, while achieving comparable F1-scores to the Multi-Task DeepLabV3 method for Pterodon emarginatus and Qualea parviflora . We hypothesize that the varying performance across species may be correlated with the complexity of their canopy shape and the indistinctness of their boundaries. This is a result that deserves further experimentation, potentially involving a greater number of samples or more refined morphological feature extraction.
blocks.zh: 如表三的总体结果所证实的,所有评估方法都显示生物漂浮物MA数据集的性能,F1分数一般超过60%,主要方法往往超过80%,见图8(b)。 在这个数据集中,Qualea parviflora提出了最重要的分化挑战,在所有模型中得出了最低的F1分数. 造成这一困难的可能原因可能在于其冠状结构的性质,尽管结构复杂,但可能与数据集中的Pterodon emarginatus物种具有微妙的形态特征,见图6。 这种物种之间的相似性可能导致模型更加模糊不清,妨碍精确的分化,从而影响Qualea parviflora的分化准确性。 反之,在Salvertia convallariodora和Tachigali aurea等物种中,模型的性能较高,其F1-分数在80%至100%之间。 本数据集中大多数物种的拟议方法都超过了DeepLabV3,同时实现了与Pterodon emarginatus和Qualea parviflora的多任务DeepLabV3方法相可比的F1-分数. 我们假设,不同物种之间的不同表现可能与其树冠形状的复杂性和其界限的模糊性有关。 这是值得进一步试验的结果,可能涉及更多的样本或更精细的形态特征取出。

blocks.en: In contrast, an analysis of Figure 8(a) , which illustrates the comparative performance of the methods for Amazon AC species, evidences the complexity of the task, as demonstrated by the variability in the results achieved by each approach. Consequently, Figure 8(a) highlights Angico and Ucuuba as the most challenging species for accurate detection. Specifically, for Angico and Ucuuba , no method demonstrated the capability to detect their instances. This challenge is likely attributable to their underrepresentation within the dataset inventory, characterized by a considerably lower number of delineated crowns compared to other included species, see Table I . Furthermore, the methods yielded relatively low accuracies, specifically ranging from 10% to 65%, for species such as Cerejeira, Guariuba, Ipê, Jutai, Massaranduba , and Samauma . Although the training sample sizes for these species were slightly larger than those for the challenging cases previously discussed, they still represent a limitation for proper training and learning. Furthermore, similar to observations in the Bioflore MA dataset, canopy structures within each species exhibit variability across individual instances. This diversity renders visual analysis challenging, even for expert human observers. Figure 5 illustrates this phenomenon, highlighting the distinct canopy shape and texture for instances of Ipê, Guariuba, Cerejeira , and Jutaí . Notwithstanding the aforementioned challenges, the proposed method exhibited superior performance over both the Single and Multi-Task versions of DeepLabV3 across most species, while achieving lower or comparable results with these methods in the remaining species.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,对图8(a)的分析显示了亚马逊大气控制物种方法的可比较性能,这证明了任务的复杂性,从每种方法所取得的成果的可变性即可看出这一点。 因此,图8(a)突出强调了Angico和Ucuuba是准确检测最具挑战性的物种。 具体地说,对Angico和Ucuuba来说,没有任何方法证明有能力检测其情况。 这一挑战可能是由于它们在数据集清单中的代表性不足,其特点是,与其他包括的物种相比,划定的冠数要少得多,见表一。 此外,这些方法的速率相对较低,具体而言,Cerejeira、Guariuba、Ipê、Jutai、Massaranduba和Samauma等物种的速率从10%到65%不等。 虽然这些物种的培训样本体积略大于先前讨论的具有挑战性的案例,但它们仍然是对适当培训和学习的一种限制。 此外,与生物漂浮物MA数据集中的观测结果类似,每个物种的树冠结构都表现出不同情况的差异。 这种多样性使得视觉分析具有挑战性,即使是对专家的人类观察员来说也是如此。 图5说明了这一现象,突出了Ipê、Guariuba、Cerejeira和Jutaí等地的明显冠状和纹理。 尽管存在上述挑战,拟议的方法在大多数物种中都表现出优于DeepLabV3的单一版本和多任务版本,同时在其余物种中取得较低或可比的结果。

blocks.en: We conclude the discussion with a qualitative analysis of the model predictions. Figures 9 and 10 show subsets of prediction overlapped to the real RGB images from both Amazon AC and Bioflore MA respectively. The image subsets on the first column represents the respective ground-truth (Figures 9 (a)(e)(i)(m) and 10 (a)(e)(i)). blocks.en: Inspecting the images in Figure 9 and 10 , a primary observation is the spatial consistency of predicted species. Baseline models, the standard DeepLabV3 and the Multi-Task DeepLabV3 exhibit reasonable performance on some instances (Figures 9 (b)(f)(g) and 10 (b)(c)), while class fragmentation in others within individual tree canopies. As seen in Figures 9 (c)(j)(k)(n)(o) and 10 (f)(g), these models often predict multiple, disjointed species labels for a single continuous canopy area.
blocks.zh: 查看图9和图10中的图像,主要观察是预测物种的空间一致性. 基准模型、标准DeepLabV3和多任务DeepLabV3在某些实例中表现出合理的性能(图9(b)(f)(g)和10(b)(c)),而其他实例则在单个树冠中显示出分类分化。 如图9(c)(j)(k)(n)(o)和图10(f)(g)所显示,这些模型往往预测一个单一连续树冠区域的多条已脱节的物种标签。

blocks.en: In contrast, the Automatic Tree Recruitment -MT approach (Figures 9 (d)(h)(l)(p) and 10 (d)(h)(l)) produces more homogeneous segmentation masks. By selecting informative samples during training, the model learns more robust feature representations that minimize spurious class transitions within a single object boundary.

blocks.en: To better understand the operational mechanics of the proposed tree recruitment method, especially regarding the computation of predictions and subsequent metrics, the process of ITC instance segmentation is visualized through a series of filtering steps, as illustrated in Figure 11 . This sequence, designed to enhance accuracy, begins with the model producing a semantically segmented image, where each pixel is assigned a label corresponding to a specific tree species (Figure 11 a). Applying a threshold to the probability image removes pixels with low confidence, thereby reducing the number of classified pixels and retaining only those with high-class membership (Figure 11 b). Further refinement occurs via a threshold on the distance transform image, improving ITC delineation (Figure 11 c). The final step involves selecting valid samples based on crown morphology, which enhances the precision of tree crown detection and contributes to the tree recruitment sample inventory (Figure 11 d).
blocks.zh: 为了更好地了解拟议树采伐方法的运作力学,特别是在计算预测和随后的衡量标准方面,如图11所示,国贸中心实例分解过程通过一系列过滤步骤可视化。 这个序列是为了提高准确性而设计的,开始于生成一个分形图像的模型,其中每个像素被分配一个对应特定树种的标签(图11 a). 对概率图像应用阈值会去除信心低的像素,从而减少被分类的像素数量并只保留那些拥有高等会籍的像素(图11b). 通过对相距变换图像设定阈值来进一步改进,改进了国贸中心的划界工作(图11c)。 最后一步涉及根据花冠形态选择有效的样品,这提高了树冠探测的精度并有助于树的采样清点(图11d).

blocks.en: As consequence, the proposed method increases the number of ITCs compared to the initial training set, which can be observed in Figure 12 in different moments during algorithm’s training. This expansion indicates a progressive improvement in the model’s ability to identify and segment tree instances across tree recruitment iterations.
blocks.zh: 因此,与初步培训相比,拟议方法增加了国贸中心的数量,在算法培训期间的不同时刻,图12可以看到这一点。 这一扩展表明,该模型在识别和分解树丛时跨树丛迭代的能力逐步得到提高。

blocks.en: Comparing the predicted crown area distributions with the reference training set is crucial for evaluating model performance. This comparison helps verify whether the model’s predictions remain aligned with the reference ITCs, ensuring that the model does not diverge from the actual crown areas. As shown in Figure 13 , the distribution of crown areas for Abiorana rosa ( Micropholis venulosa ) is analyzed, using selection limits from the first iteration. Blue bars represent the predicted samples, reflecting the model’s estimation of crown area distribution, while orange bars indicate the reference training ITCs. The results reveal that most predicted ITCs have areas ranging from 0 to 100 m², which are smaller than the median and consequently excluded from the sample inventory.
blocks.zh: 将预测的冠地分布与参考培训对照,对评价模型性能至关重要。 这种比较有助于核实该模型的预测是否与参考贸易中心保持一致,确保该模型不与实际冠区相去甚远。 如图13所显示,对Abiorana rosa(微阴囊)的冠地分布进行了分析,采用了从第一次迭代开始的选择限制。 蓝条代表预测的样本,反映了模型对冠地分布的估计,而橙条则表示参考训练中心。 结果显示,大多数预测的国贸中心的面积从0至100平方米不等,小于中位数,因此被排除在抽样清单之外。

blocks.en: Fig. 13 : Comparison of the canopy area distribution of the species Abiorana rosa ( Micropholis venulosa ). Highlighted are the selection limits used in the first iteration of the model.
blocks.zh: 图13: Abiorana rosa(微泡花)物种冠地分布比较. 突出的是模型第一次迭代中使用的选取限制.

blocks.en: Figure 14 presents the proposed method behaviour when considering how the number of Individual Tree Crowns (ITCs) detected and the F1-score in each datasets change, across 20 iterations. On the left y-axis, the Nº of ITCs is displayed, ranging from 0 to over 3000, while the F1-score is on the right y-axis, presented as a percentage from 0 to 100. The x-axis represents the Iteration count, from 0 to 20. Four distinct lines illustrate the key metrics for each dataset: a dashed orange line denotes Nº ITCs - Bioflore MA, a dashed blue line represents Nº ITCs - Amazon AC, a solid orange line with circles signifies F1-score - Bioflore MA, and a solid blue line with circles indicates F1-score - Amazon AC.
blocks.zh: 图14列出了拟议方法行为,考虑了在20个迭代中发现的单个树冠数量和每个数据集F1分的变化。 在左Y轴上,显示ITCs的编号从0到3000多,而F1分数在右Y轴上,显示百分比从0到100. x轴代表迭代计数,从0到20. 四条不同的线说明了每个数据集的关键度量:一条有破折痕的橙线表示没有ITCs-Bioflore MA;一条有破折痕的蓝线代表没有ITCs-Amazon AC;一条有圆形的实心橙线表示F1-分数-Bioflore MA;一条有圆形的实心蓝线表示F1-分数-Amazon AC.

blocks.en: Analyzing the results depicted in Figure 14 , a clear trend emerges for both datasets. For the Bioflore MA dataset (orange lines), the number of detected ITCs (orange dashed line) demonstrates a continuous increase across the tree recruitment cycles, starting from approximately 700 ITCs at iteration 1 and escalating to over 3100 ITCs by iteration 20. Concurrently, the F1-score for Bioflore MA (solid orange line) exhibits stability and high performance, hovering around 85% from iteration 1 to iteration 14, peaking at approximately 92% between iterations 15 and 19, before a slight decrease to around 85% by iteration 20. This indicates that the tree recruitment approach expanded the number of identified ITCs without compromising the accuracy of the model, successfully maintaining a high F1-score.
blocks.zh: 分析图14所示结果后,两个数据集出现明显趋势。 就生物漂流MA数据集(橙线)而言,所检测的国贸中心(橙线破碎)数量表明,整个树类征聘周期持续增加,从第一迭代的约700个国贸中心开始,再由第二十迭代上升到3100多个国贸中心。 同时,Bioflore MA(固体橙线)的F1分显示稳定性和高性能,从第1集到第14集徘徊在85%左右,在第15集到第19集之间达到约92%的高峰,再由第20集略微下降到约85%. 这表明,在不损害模型准确性的情况下,树上征聘办法扩大了已查明的贸易中心的数目,成功地维持了高分F1分。

blocks.en: Fig. 14 : Number of individual tree crowns (ITCs) detected and macro-average F1-score across tree recruitment iterations.
blocks.zh: 图14:发现的单个树冠的数量和整个树种招聘周期的宏观平均数F1-分数。

blocks.en: Similarly, for the Amazon AC dataset (blue lines), the number of detected ITCs (dashed blue line) also shows a steady growth, increasing from around 495 ITCs at iteration 1 to approximately 956 ITCs by iteration 20. The F1-score for Amazon AC (solid blue line), while generally lower than that of Bioflore MA, also experiences an overall upward trend, albeit with more pronounced fluctuations. It commences around 50% and reaches its highest point near 54% around iteration 13, stabilizing around 50% towards the later iterations. For instance, between iterations 8 and 20, the F1-score remained steady, while the number of detected ITCs rose from 782 to 956, respectively. This suggests that even for a potentially more challenging or distinct dataset like Amazon AC, self-training contributes to an increased discovery of ITCs and an improvement in predictive accuracy over iterations, though the F1-score performance is not as high or stable as observed for Bioflore MA. The overall performance across both datasets confirms the effectiveness of tree recruitment in iteratively improving the annotation process by identifying more high-confidence individual tree crowns while sustaining or improving model accuracy.
blocks.zh: 同样地,在亚马逊AC数据集(蓝线)中,检测到的ITC(蓝线)数量也呈现出稳步增长,从第1版的约495个ITC增加到第20版的约956个ITC. Amazon AC的F1-分数(实心蓝线)虽然一般低于Bioflore MA,但也出现了总体上升趋势,尽管波动更明显. 它开始于50%左右,在13号电站周围达到最高点近54%,稳定在50%左右,然后转向后期电站。 例如,在8至20个重迭之间,F1分数保持稳定,而检测到的国贸中心数量则分别从782个增至956个。 这表明,即使对亚马逊大气控制这种可能更具挑战性或独特的数据集而言,自我培训也有助于更多地发现国贸中心,并改进对迭代的预测准确性,尽管F1分数的性能不如对Bioflore MA的观测那样高或稳定。 这两套数据集的总体业绩证实,通过确定更自信的单个树冠,同时保持或提高模型的准确性,树的招聘在反复改进注释过程方面是有效的。

blocks.en: An observation, illustrated by the F1-score trajectories in Figure 14 , is that an expectation of continuous, monotonic improvement in classification accuracy through successive tree recruitment iterations is not always realistic. This outcome is a direct consequence of the self-training strategy employed, which, by its design, prioritizes the inclusion of only high-confidence samples into the inventory during each iteration. This selective inclusion means that the most challenging and ambiguous, i.e., borderline, samples where the model exhibits lower certainty, are systematically excluded from the model’s direct training process. Because only confident candidates are recruited, these difficult cases, which are crucial for pushing the model’s performance further, are left out of the automatic loop; in practice, they are the natural candidates to be delegated to human expert annotators.
blocks.zh: 图14中的F1-分数轨迹表明,期望通过接连的树招募迭代来不断,单调地提高分类精度并不总是现实的. 这一成果是采用自我培训战略的直接结果,根据这一战略的设计,在每个周期期间,只将高度自信样本列入清单。 这种选择性的列入意味着,最有挑战性和模棱两可的界限,即模型显示确定性较低的样本,被系统地排除在模型的直接培训进程之外。 由于只招聘自信的候选人,这些对进一步推动模型业绩至关重要的困难案例被置身于自动循环之外;实际上,他们是自然而然被下放给人类专家注释员的候选人。

blocks.en: However, even relying on human annotation for these complex cases presents its own set of challenges. Within diverse environments, such as those represented by Bioflore MA and Amazon AC, the task of accurately discerning between species, often based on subtle morphological distinctions, can be difficult even for highly trained human experts. The current taxonomic complexities and the sheer volume of species further compound this challenge, making definitive and consistent labeling of borderline samples a challenging task. Consequently, as depicted by the F1-scores, the plateauing for Bioflore MA at a high level and the more fluctuating, modest gains for Amazon AC, the model’s ability to improve beyond a certain threshold becomes constrained. This highlights a key limitation of high-confidence-based tree recruitment when confronted with complex and ambiguous classification tasks, where the easy examples are quickly exhausted and the hard examples remain a persistent challenge for both machines and humans.
blocks.zh: 然而,即使对这些复杂案件依靠人的说明也提出了自己的一系列挑战。 在多种环境中,如以Bioflore MA和亚马逊大气控制为代表的环境中,精确辨别物种的任务往往基于微妙的形态区别,即使对于训练有素的人类专家来说,也很难做到。 目前分类的复杂性和物种数量之多进一步加剧了这一挑战,使边界样品的确定和一致标签成为一项艰巨的任务。 因此,正如F1-分数、高水平的Bioflore MA高地和亚马逊空调公司更起伏和微小的收益所描述的那样,模型超过某一阈值的改进能力受到限制。 这突出表明,在面临复杂而模糊的分类任务时,以高自信为基础的树的招聘是一个关键限制,因为简单的例子很快就用尽了,而硬例子仍然是机器和人类面临的一个长期挑战。

blocks.en: We conclude the discussion with an analysis of the progression of ITCs added to the sample inventory during the self-training iterations. With this aim, Figure 15 represents such a behavior and the average F1-score per species at iterations 1, 8, and 13 (shown in parentheses) on Amazon AC dataset. The primary objective of this figure is to illustrate the expansion of the training set driven by the recruitment criteria. Thus, rather than statistic representation of a dataset, the bar plot serves as a record of the model’s acquisition priorities. It highlights how the proposed framework identified and incorporated ITCs into the inventory. This analysis focuses on the Amazon AC dataset, as it represents the most challenging scenario among the datasets evaluated in this study.
blocks.zh: 在结束讨论时,我们分析了在自我培训周期期间在抽样清单中增列的国贸中心的进展情况。 为此,图15代表了这种行为,在亚马逊AC数据集的第1,8和13个迭代中,每个物种的平均分为F1-分(括号中为shown). 这一数字的主要目的是说明征聘标准所推动的培训的扩大。 因此,条形图不是对数据集的统计,而是对该模型购置优先次序的记录。 报告着重说明了拟议框架如何确定贸易中心并将其纳入清单。 这一分析侧重于亚马逊大气控制数据集,因为它代表了本研究所评价的数据集中最具挑战性的情景.

blocks.en: By inspecting the figure, can be observed that twelve species exhibited an increase in the number of ITCs from iteration 1 to 13, while five species ( Angico Vermelho , Cerejeira , Samauma , Angico , and Ucuuba ) kept a constant count. Cedro was the species with more ITCs (118) in the final iteration of the tree recruitment process. On the other hand, the F1-score at the same time increased for the following species: Castanheira , Jutai , Tauari , Garapeira , Cumaru Ferro , Angico Vermelho , Cerejeira , and Samauma from the first to the 13th iteration. The largest improvement was observed in Jutai , with an increase of 23.2 percentage points, followed by Cerejeira with an increase of 11.1 percentage points. In contrast, six species, i.e., Ipê , Massaranduba , Cedro , Guaribeiro , Tachi , and Abiorana Rosa , experienced a decline in F1-score.
blocks.zh: 通过检查该数字,可以发现有12个物种的贸易中心数目从第1集增加到第13集,而5个物种(Angico Vermelho、Cerejeira、Samauma、Angico和Ucuuba)则不断统计。 赛德罗是树上招生过程最终迭代中拥有较多ITC(118)的物种. 另一方面,F1分同时为以下物种增分: Castanheira, Jutai, Tauari, Garapeira, Cumaru Ferro, Angico Vermelho, Cerejeira, 和 Samauma 从第一到第十三代. 朱泰的改善最大,上升了23.2%,其次是塞雷杰拉,上升了11.1%。 相形之下,有6个物种,即:叶平(Ipê),马萨兰多巴(Massaranduba),塞德罗(Cedro),瓜里贝罗(Guaribeiro),塔奇(Tachi)和阿比奥拉娜·罗莎(Abiorana Rosa),经历了F1-分数的下降.

blocks.en: Fig. 15 : Number of predicted individual tree crowns (ITCs) in the 1st, 8th, and 13th iterations of the tree recruitment cycle. A different bar color represents each species. The count of ITCs is displayed above each bar, with the corresponding F1-score in parentheses.
blocks.zh: 图15:第1,第8,第13回树招募周期中预测的单个树冠(ITCs)数量. 不同条形花色代表了每个物种. 贸易中心的计数列在每一栏上方,括号内为相应的F1-分数。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This work presented a framework for reliable tree recruitment that progressively expands forest species inventories from a limited set of annotated individual tree crowns (ITCs) using high-resolution UAV imagery. The proposed framework combines multi-task semantic segmentation, confidence estimation, and morphology-aware validation to automatically recruit reliable tree crowns while preserving inventory quality throughout the expansion process.
blocks.zh: 这项工作为可靠地征聘树种提供了一个框架,利用高分辨率无人驾驶飞行器图像,逐步扩大森林物种清单,从有限的一套附加说明的个别树冠中扩展。 拟议的框架结合了多任务语义分解,信心估计和形态学-意识验证,以自动地招募可靠的树冠,同时在整个扩展过程中保持库存质量.

blocks.en: Experimental results on two tropical forest datasets demonstrated that the progressive expansion of the inventory consistently improves tree species detection and classification compared with established semantic segmentation baselines, with marked gains for some species represented by few annotated crowns (e.g., Jutai ), although the rarest species, with fewer than ten annotated crowns, remained undetected by all methods. These results indicate that reliable tree recruitment provides an effective mechanism for reducing the dependence on extensive manual annotation while enabling scalable forest inventory expansion under scarce supervision.
blocks.zh: 对两个热带森林数据集的实验结果表明,与既定的语义分化基线相比,清单的逐步扩展不断改进了树种的探测和分类,一些物种的显著收益以少数有注释的花冠(如朱泰)为代表,尽管最罕见的物种,只有不到10个有注释的花冠,但所有方法都未被发现. 这些结果表明,可靠的树采伐为减少对大量人工注解的依赖提供了有效机制,同时在很少的监督下,能够扩大可扩展的森林库存。

blocks.en: Although the proposed framework performs well across distinct tropical forest environments, challenges remain in highly heterogeneous canopies, where overlapping crowns and complex forest structures can still affect segmentation quality and the reliability of automatically recruited samples. Future work will investigate the integration of multimodal remote sensing data, more advanced uncertainty estimation strategies, and the application of the proposed framework to larger and more diverse forest inventories.
blocks.zh: 虽然拟议框架在不同的热带森林环境中表现良好,但在高度多样化的树冠中仍然存在挑战,在树冠相重叠和复杂的森林结构中,仍然会影响到分化质量和自动采集样品的可靠性。 今后的工作将研究如何整合多模式遥感数据、更先进的不确定性估计战略,以及将拟议框架应用于更大和更多样化的森林清单。

blocks.en: Overall, this study demonstrates that progressive and reliable tree recruitment offers a practical pathway for automatically expanding forest species inventories, supporting biodiversity monitoring in data-scarce environments without requiring extensive new field campaigns or large-scale manual annotation.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,本研究报告表明,逐步和可靠的树采伐为自动扩大森林物种清单提供了一个切实可行的途径,支持在缺乏数据的环境中进行生物多样性监测,而无需开展广泛的新的实地活动或大规模人工说明。
